Priya Nair: Quick follow-up from today's failover validation run — observed two gaps: snapshot manifest mismatch and DNS TTL drift during aggressive failover. Want owners and short ETAs.
Ethan Wu: I'll take snapshot validation improvements. Plan: add sha256 manifest check + CI smoke. ETA: 2025-05-05.
Sam Li: I'll own DNS TTL enforcement and a Route53 sanity check. Add a small playbook snippet to revert TTLs quickly. ETA: 2025-05-03.
Jules Ford: I'll document a condensed restore runbook (playable in <30m) and include cache-warm step after DNS flip. ETA: 2025-05-07.
Priya Nair: Suggest monthly mini game days (single microservice, staged) to catch process regressions. Who can coordinate first one?
Ethan Wu: I can coordinate the first rehearsal in May. Will set calendar and a short checklist.
incident-bot: Incident 1912349999 logged. Postmortem link: https://redwood-internal/postmortems/1912349999 (automated).
Priya Nair: Thanks — I'll create a simple action tracker sheet and ping for :thumbsup: when owners confirm.
